mentions.name: Portable USB-PD bench power supply
mentions.description: A small, portable USB-PD bench power supply offering regulated 3V3, 5V, and 12V outputs plus unregulated PPS/EPR AVS pass-through, run by an RP2040 that drives an OLED screen and buttons for configuration. A separate galvanically isolated USB-C CDC-ACM port handles data: it dumps CSV by default and switches to a native protocol via handshake with a desktop app (live graphs, configuration, alarms) and a CLI (config control, live readings, TOML-defined test plans), with a PyO3 wrapper for easy scripting. Firmware is Rust/Embassy and the GUI/CLI are Rust/egui/Ratatui; the goal is a form factor about the size of a pack of cigarettes.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also working on a small, portable USB-PD bench power supply: Regulated 3V3, 5V, 12V & unregulated PPS/EPR AVS pass-through. RP2040 running the show, driving a little OLED screen & some buttons for configuration.
